# FlareRibbon

`Flare.Components.IDE.FlareRibbon`

Ribbon component with tabbed command groups. Each FlareRibbonTab child defines a tab containing FlareRibbonGroup groups of commands. Composed entirely from base Flare CSS classes - no custom tokens.
